title: Partner Integrations Module
summary: This module provides integrations with various external AI service providers and data platforms, including LLMs, embedding models, search engines, and vector stores. It enables LangChain applications to leverage a wide array of third-party capabilities.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM
nodes.title: Anthropic LLM Integration
nodes.description: Provides an interface for interacting with Anthropic's legacy text completion models, handling prompt formatting and API calls.

nodes.label: Anthropic Tool Middleware
nodes.title: Anthropic Tool Middleware
nodes.description: Manages Anthropic's text editor and memory tools, storing file content in LangGraph state or local filesystem.

nodes.label: Anthropic File Search Middleware
nodes.title: Anthropic File Search Middleware
nodes.description: Enables glob and grep search functionalities over virtual files stored in the agent's state for Anthropic tools.

nodes.label: Anthropic Prompt Caching Middleware
nodes.title: Anthropic Prompt Caching Middleware
nodes.description: Optimizes API usage for Anthropic models by applying cache control to conversation prefixes, system messages, and tool definitions.

nodes.label: Anthropic Tools Output Parser
nodes.title: Anthropic Tools Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses tool call information from Anthropic model generations, converting them into structured formats or Pydantic models.

nodes.label: Exa Search Retriever
nodes.title: Exa Search Retriever
nodes.description: Retrieves relevant documents from the Exa search engine based on a query and various filtering options.

nodes.label: Exa Search Tools
nodes.title: Exa Search Tools
nodes.description: Provides tools for performing web searches and finding similar content using the Exa API.

nodes.label: Fireworks Embeddings
nodes.title: Fireworks Embeddings
nodes.description: Generates vector embeddings for text using models hosted by Fireworks AI.

nodes.label: Groq Message Converters
nodes.title: Groq Message Converters
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of message formats between LangChain's internal representation and Groq's API requirements, including streaming chunks.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Chat Model
nodes.title: HuggingFace Chat Model
nodes.description: Integrates various HuggingFace LLMs (e.g., TextGenInference, Endpoint, Hub, Pipeline) as chat models, supporting generation, streaming, and tool calling.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Pipeline LLM
nodes.title: HuggingFace Pipeline LLM
nodes.description: Provides an interface for using HuggingFace models via their pipeline API for tasks like text generation, summarization, and translation.

nodes.label: MistralAI Output Converter
nodes.title: MistralAI Output Converter
nodes.description: Utility for converting structured output schemas into a format compatible with OpenAI's response format, used by MistralAI integrations.

nodes.label: Ollama LLM
nodes.title: Ollama LLM
nodes.description: Integrates with local Ollama language models, supporting text generation, streaming, and optional reasoning modes.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation Middleware
nodes.title: OpenAI Moderation Middleware
nodes.description: Moderates agent inputs, outputs, and tool results using OpenAI's moderation API to detect and handle unsafe content.

nodes.label: OpenAI Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.title: OpenAI Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator to create custom tools compatible with OpenAI's function calling API, allowing flexible tool definition.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Chat Model
nodes.title: OpenRouter Chat Model
nodes.description: Integrates with the OpenRouter unified API, providing access to various chat models with advanced features like attribution, reasoning, and provider preferences.

nodes.label: Perplexity Search Retriever
nodes.title: Perplexity Search Retriever
nodes.description: Retrieves search results from the Perplexity AI search engine, offering various filtering and result customization options.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.description: Provides a modern integration with Qdrant for vector storage and retrieval, supporting dense, sparse, and hybrid embedding modes.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store (Legacy)
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Store (Legacy)
nodes.description: Offers a legacy integration with Qdrant for vector storage and retrieval, primarily supporting dense embeddings.

nodes.label: Base LLM
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface for large language models (LLMs).

nodes.label: Base Chat Model
nodes.title: Base Chat Model
nodes.description: Defines the base interface for chat-oriented language models.

nodes.label: Base Retriever
nodes.title: Base Retriever
nodes.description: Abstract base class for document retrieval systems.

nodes.label: Base Vector Store
nodes.title: Base Vector Store
nodes.description: Abstract base class for vector database integrations.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: Base Tool
nodes.description: Base class for defining tools that agents can use.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser
nodes.title: Base Output Parser
nodes.description: Base class for parsing model outputs into structured formats.

nodes.label: Base Agent Middleware
nodes.title: Base Agent Middleware
nodes.description: Base class for intercepting and modifying agent execution flow.

nodes.label: Base Embeddings
nodes.title: Base Embeddings
nodes.description: Abstract base class for text embedding models.

nodes.label: Core Message Types
nodes.title: Core Message Types
nodes.description: Represents various types of messages used in conversational AI (e.g., Human, AI, System).

nodes.label: Core Usage Metadata
nodes.title: Core Usage Metadata
nodes.description: Standardized structure for reporting token usage and other API metrics.
